name: skills-selector
description: Meta-skill gatekeeper that runs FIRST on every task to decide which other skill(s) — if any — should activate. Analyzes the user request with a bounded decision-native state, typed candidate questions, explicit policy clamps, and confidence-aware fail-open fallback, then emits a tight SELECTION plan so other skills are loaded on-demand only. Minimizes token/context consumption by refusing to activate heavy skills unless clearly justified. Triggers on ANY user instruction that could plausibly benefit from a specialized skill — i.e. essentially every turn that starts new work. This is vendor-neutral and does not require a Jev or TypeSafe runtime.
